page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g9i.2xlarge offers a standard general-purpose profile with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring predictable compute performance without the risk of resource contention found in shared-core instances. This configuration is suitable for balanced workloads such as mid-sized web servers, application hosting, enterprise applications, and general-purpose development or testing environments.
